display.purpose: Uppercase only; black type on colored LCARS caps and reader headings.

body.purpose: All prose and data; long-form at 85% foreground mix.

label.purpose: 10px uppercase 0.3em-tracked steel — the header voice of panels and sections.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: SlideOver overlay layer only — the single sanctioned shadow (Flat-At-Rest Rule).

motion.name: hud-glow
motion.purpose: Live-data glow; never on static content.

components.name: LCARS Nav Cap
components.description: One-sided pill navigation bar in its channel color; black Antonio label, dim-until-active.
components.css: .ds-nav-cap { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; height: 48px; width: 160px; padding: 12px; background: var(--lcars-lavender, #cc99cc); border-radius: 9999px 0 0 9999px; opacity: 0.5; transition: opacity 0.2s; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-cap:hover { opacity: 0.8; } .ds-nav-cap[aria-current="page"] { opacity: 1; } .ds-nav-cap span { font-family: Antonio, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #000; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Full-pill bordered micro-chip; steel at rest, channel color when selected.
components.css: .ds-chip { border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid var(--panel-edge, #1a2233); background: transparent; padding: 2px 10px; font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--lcars-steel, #6688aa); transition: color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { color: var(--foreground, #d8e4f0); border-color: var(--lcars-steel, #6688aa); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--hud-cyan, #35e0ff); } .ds-chip--selected { color: var(--hud-cyan, #35e0ff); border-color: var(--hud-cyan, #35e0ff); }

components.name: Quiet Button
components.description: Default control: bordered, steel, shifts toward the action's channel color on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-quiet { border-radius: 0.375rem; border: 1px solid var(--panel-edge, #1a2233); background: transparent; padding: 4px 10px; font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--lcars-steel, #6688aa); transition: color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-quiet:hover { color: var(--lcars-salmon, #ff7788); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--lcars-salmon, #ff7788) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--hud-cyan, #35e0ff); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: The universal raised surface: tonal step up from space-black, 1px edge, micro-label header, no shadow.
components.html:
SYSTEM STATUS

All tools nominal.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: var(--panel, #0b0e14); border: 1px solid var(--panel-edge, #1a2233); border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 12px; } .ds-panel-label { font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 400; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.3em; color: var(--hud-cyan, #35e0ff); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--panel-edge, #1a2233); padding-bottom: 4px; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-panel-body { font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.7; color: var(--foreground, #d8e4f0); margin: 0; }

components.name: Micro-label
components.description: The system's header voice — 10px uppercase, 0.3em tracking, steel.
components.css: .ds-microlabel { font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.3em; color: var(--lcars-steel, #6688aa); }

components.name: Live Status Line
components.description: Glowing cyan telemetry for live data — the Glow Means Live Rule made visible.
components.css: .ds-live { font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: var(--hud-cyan, #35e0ff); text-shadow: 0 0 8px color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 60%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Panel-toned field with edge border; brightens on focus with the cyan outline.
components.css: .ds-input { background: var(--panel, #0b0e14); border: 1px solid var(--panel-edge, #1a2233); border-radius: 0.375rem; padding: 6px 10px; font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--foreground, #d8e4f0); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--lcars-steel, #6688aa); letter-spacing: 0.1em; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--hud-cyan, #35e0ff); border-color: var(--lcars-steel, #6688aa); }

narrative.overview: Tarik OS looks like a starship bridge station wired to one person's actual life. The screen is an instrument, not a document: near-black space, ice-blue monospace telemetry, and LCARS end-caps routing you to each subsystem. The room is dark and calm; the data is what glows. Nothing decorates — every color, glow, and pulse is a reading. The system is quiet by default and alive by exception. Static information sits flat in bordered panels; anything currently live earns the cyan HUD glow. Density is embraced; hierarchy comes from tracking-spaced micro-labels and channel color, never from size inflation.
keyCharacteristics: Dark, flat, instrument-panel surfaces — depth from borders and tone, not shadows
LCARS one-sided pill caps as the navigation signature; black display type on colored caps
Monospace body voice throughout; wide-tracked uppercase micro-labels as wayfinding
Color is routing and status, never mood
Glow and pulse are reserved signals for live/waiting states; motion-reduce always respected

rules.name: The Channel Color Rule
rules.body: Every surface owns an LCARS hue (amber HOME, lavender BRIEFS/MAIL, blue BRAIN, cyan TELOS/VIEW, salmon COMMS, steel CTRL). Color assignments route and identify; they never express mood, and new surfaces claim a channel color before shipping.

rules.name: The Glow Means Live Rule
rules.body: hud-glow (soft currentColor text-shadow) appears only on data that is live right now — an open session, streaming state, fresh telemetry. Glowing static text is a defect.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Antonio speaks only in caps, on caps and headings; Geist Mono says everything else. No third typeface enters the bridge.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat, by doctrine. Depth is conveyed by tone and the 1px panel-edge border — never by resting shadows. Exactly one layer is allowed shadow: the overlay layer.

rules.name: The One-Sided Pill Rule
rules.body: The LCARS end-cap — fully rounded on exactly one side — is the system's signature silhouette. Everything else is quiet geometry: 6px controls, 8px panels, full pills for chips.

dos: Do give every new surface a channel color from the LCARS family and use it consistently in its nav cap, chips, and accents.
Do use the micro-label (10px uppercase, 0.3em tracking, steel) as the header voice for panels and sections.
Do keep all interactive elements on the focus-visible:outline-2 outline-cyan-hud treatment and pair every transition with motion-reduce.
Do hand-roll chips and status styling in Tailwind utilities per house style — shared logic goes in src/lib, not a component library.
Do render text on colored caps in black Antonio uppercase.
donts: Don't add resting shadows, gradients-as-decoration, or glow on static content — flat at rest, glow means live.
Don't introduce a third typeface, humanist sans body text, or lowercase display type.
Don't use channel colors for mood or emphasis outside their surface (salmon is COMMS/destructive-hover, not a highlight color).
Don't ship borderless floating panels — every raised surface carries the 1px panel-edge border.
Don't bring in a component library for visual primitives; the system is hand-rolled Tailwind on the token set.
